title: finding(docs): the weekly `check-links` run is red on `main` — ten docs links cite objectui issues that answer 404 (`ci-cd-pipeline.md` ×8, `lookup.mdx`, `select.mdx`)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect in published documentation with named sites, measured (class a, docs). Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`). This seat met the red while re-reading `main`'s checks. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Measured

The weekly `check-links` workflow (lychee, `schedule: '17 4 * * 0'`; it never runs on a pull request) ran on `main` `01700dcd7d` at 2026-09-27T04:32Z and failed with exit code 2. Run `36294593837`, job `108550980184`: 1024 links checked, 10 errors, every one a `404` on an objectui issue link.

| file | cited issue | position |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` | objectui#5793 | 2259:23 |
| `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` | objectui#6943, objectui#7627, objectui#7638, objectui#7753, objectui#8057 | line 237 |
| `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` | objectui#7878 | 244:1819 |
| `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` | objectui#7791 | 338:4 |
| `content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx` | objectui#7014 | 76:2 |
| `content/docs/fields/select.mdx` | objectui#9230 | 130:2 |

The REST API answers `404 Not Found` for each issue this seat spot-checked (objectui#5793, #7014, #7627, #9230). So the numbers are gone from the board, not only unreachable anonymously.

**Not measured:** why. The same class was measured on objectui#10701 (closed, fixed by PR objectui#10707): citations of issues that no longer answer. Issues hidden with a suspended account read the same way, but this seat did not establish it for these ten.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

The objectui#10701 / PR objectui#10707 shape applies to each site: cite what still answers (the landing commit, a live successor card, or the ADR or ruling the sentence rests on) instead of a dead issue number. Where nothing answers, drop the citation and keep the sentence only if it stands alone. ⛔ Not a fix: an exclude pattern in the lychee config for these URLs, which would hide the next dead citation too.

The workflow is scheduled only, so no pull request shows this red; it surfaces weekly on `main`.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, matched against `check-links|lychee|404.{0,40}(issue|link)|dead issue|answer 404`: no card for these ten sites. The hits are objectui#10701 and PR objectui#10707 (the same class, other sites, closed) and PR bodies listing the gate.

Dedupe words: `check-links 404 issue citations docs` · `ci-cd-pipeline.md dead issue links` · `lychee main red weekly`
